author: Business Insider
description:
From the kitchens of Qatar Airways to the slopes of Everest, we explore 21 of the most fascinating jobs on the planet. Meet the Sherpa guides who lead climbers to the world's highest peak, the Himalayan truck drivers navigating mountain roads, and the artisans behind ballet shoes, Pantone colors, and professional colored pencils. We also spend time with a Southern cafeteria owner, a lobster catcher, the nannies trained at London's elite Norland College, and the crew responsible for getting every NFL football game-ready.
